payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **RUL90 (the raw dispatch doors are removed; dispatch is the lower layer and fanout belongs to the Work layer, 2026-10-14; decision 0062, replaces the purpose-door part of RUL68 (2 tầng dispatch) and the one-posture-lane-per-door part of RUL77 (posture belongs to the capability)).** Work is executed through two doors only, `fgos run` (`"<prompt>"`, `--unit`, `--resume`) and `fgos workflow start`, both on `runUnit`. `dispatch execute` (executor id, `--contract`, `--assignment`), `dispatch log` and `dispatch fanout-batch` are gone, with `src/runner/dispatch-log.mjs`; calling `dispatch execute` (any form) or `dispatch log` returns a `validation` error with one sentence naming the replacement (`fgos run "<prompt>" [--provider <executor>] [--capability <c>] [--writes …]` or `fgos run --unit`, where `--provider` is named only for an agent executor — `fgos run` refuses any other kind — the `--for` capability is kept when it is registered, and a tool executor's caller is told to call that tool directly; the dispatch-decide hook's BLOCKED message is built the same way, by `runDoorHint`; `fgos run --unit` or a Workflow for `--assignment`; provenance under `.fgos/assignments/<unitRunId>/` for `dispatch log`), from one place in `bin`, also for `returnResult` callers. `executeExecutorCli` has no CLI door left: it is the transport step of an Assignment (`assignment-runner.mjs`), and its one other caller, `fanout-batch.mjs`, is listed in `R3_PENDING_WORK_CALLERS` until fanout runs on `runUnit`; `fgos dispatch` keeps `decide`, `inspect`, `reconcile` and `probe-account`. `src/runner/dispatch.mjs` imports nothing from the Work layer: `decide --work` gets its Work resolver injected from `bin`, so it runs only as `fgos dispatch decide --work`. A Unit's posture comes from its `writes` (none: read-only, sandboxed; some: mutating, in a linked worktree) plus the capability's required confinement, never from which door was used. Fanout adds no verb: `node src/runner/fanout-batch.mjs "<ids>" [--has-live-task-access]` prints `fired`, `mechanismChanged`, `unavailable`, `deferred` (plus `slotsFull: true` when no slot was free); its body moves onto `runUnit` with the Work-layer cut. An import guard (`test/architecture.test.mjs`) keeps `dispatch.mjs` and `src/workflow/**` free of Work imports, following relative imports transitively (a re-export one or more hops away counts) and reading `require()` and literal `import()`; a call-site guard over `src`, `bin`, `scripts`, `domains` and `core` names the files allowed to call `executeAssignment`, `executeExecutorCli`, `commitUnitWork` and `executeThroughConfinement` (an aliased, destructured or namespace use counts as a call; `export *` from their home modules is refused), with Work-layer callers not yet on `runUnit` listed in `R3_PENDING_WORK_CALLERS`, compared by equality so the list can only shrink. An `import()` with a non-literal specifier is not yet seen by the import guard (left to the dispatch-generic-inputs phase). [Closed by RUL95 (dispatch takes generic inputs only): a computed `import()`/`require()`, `createRequire`, `node:module` and `eval` are refused in the guarded files outside a named allowlist; `R3_PENDING_WORK_CALLERS` is empty and deleted.] The doctrine test `test/docs/run-doors-doctrine.test.mjs` refuses `AGENTS.md`, any skill source or any render that still teaches a removed door.

payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **RUL89 (`fgos workflow start --units <file>` runs a list of Units as a one-off Workflow, 2026-10-14; decision 0061).** The units file (YAML/JSON, `{ id?, title?, units }` or a list of Units, `src/workflow/units-source.mjs`) becomes one step per Unit, `dependsOn` becomes step dependencies, a Unit id must be a safe branch-name segment, and the workflow id is `units/<id|basename>`. The `units-file` source is passed by the loader to the validator, never read from the data, and is the only source whose unit templates may carry `prefer`. `--seats` is refused with `--units`. `--effort <level>` (`low|medium|high|max`, otherwise refused before a run exists) becomes an override `{ reasoningEffort, origin: 'human-cli' }` for every unit, stored in `workflow.start` and reused on resume. A unit template's `persona` travels on the Unit (provenance `unit`); persona overrides remain only for `--seats` seats. A writing unit that stands on exactly one writing ancestor (directly or through read-only units; an integrate step cuts the path) starts its worktree from that unit's branch sha; a file with a writing unit standing on two or more writing units is refused at start; nothing is merged automatically and `workflow status` lists `writeBranches` (branch, worktree, base). A unit that wrote outside its scope (reported by its commit, or found in its branch diff outside `writeScope`) ends `findings` (`out-of-scope-writes`); a unit standing on that branch inherits only the out-of-scope paths the branch carries; an integrate step whose dependency is flagged fails and merges nothing. A writing unit that gets no worktree of its own (base branch gone, worktree creation failed) fails and never runs in the shared checkout. Residual: a writing unit after an integrate step still starts from the main checkout's HEAD, not the integrate target.
